candidates.cluster_label: Samsung Heavy Industries - Dynagas (Oceania-disclosed) 4x 200,000cbm LNG carriers - vessel 1 of 4
candidates.discovery_notes: Samsung Heavy disclosed (DART, Mon 14-Sep-2026) a contract with an unidentified 'Oceania-based' owner for four 200,000 cu m LNG carriers, delivery by September 2029, combined value reported as ~$1.01bn (en.sedaily) / ~$1.05bn (Splash247) - two independently-reported total-price figures in the same ballpark, so per-vessel price is NOT included here (no source states a clean per-vessel USD figure that would pass the literal value-corroboration gate; computed averages would be ~$250-262.5M but that is my arithmetic, not sourced text). Splash247 (citing Greek market/broker sources) identifies the owner as Dynagas (George Procopiou), noting this is 'a change of builder' for Dynagas's large-LNG programme (previously concentrated at HD Hyundai Heavy Industries) - same identification pattern used elsewhere in this backend for broker-attributed owners (e.g. Purus Marine, Celsius Tankers), so graded G on two independent sources agreeing on yard/count/date, with the owner attribution flagged as market-source (not an official Samsung/DART naming). Not in baseline: baseline's latest Samsung HI contract date is 08-Jun-2026 (unknown shipowner 2). Vessel type: 200,000 cbm doesn't cleanly match the q-flex/q-max controlled-vocab bands (~210k/~266k) so left as 'conventional'. Propulsion type not stated in sources - omitted.

candidates.cluster_label: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries - Tsakos Energy Navigation (TEN Ltd), 2nd LNG carrier / exercised option
candidates.discovery_notes: TEN Ltd's own press release (GlobeNewswire, 01-Jul-2026) announces a SECOND LNG carrier order at HD Hyundai Heavy Industries, explicitly described as 'an option attached to the order announced in February' (i.e. an exercised option on the Feb-2026 contract already in the backend as HD Hyundai HI (HHI) Ulsan 3643 / Tsakos, 25-Feb-2026, 174000cbm, 2028). This is a genuinely new hull, in scope per the task brief ('exercised option'). Riviera corroborates: price ~US$254M, delivery by January 2029 (Q1 2029), yard HD Hyundai Heavy Industries. This July disclosure lines up with HD Korea Shipbuilding's same-day (30-Jun-2026 signing / reported 01-Jul-2026) 392.2 billion won LNG-carrier disclosure (~$253M at the same day's exchange rate implied by the $570.7M/885bn-won combined figure) - consistent with this being that vessel. Capacity: not explicitly re-stated as '174,000' in the confirmed-order articles (Riviera/GlobeNewswire), so Capacity is left OUT of row_data per the literal-value rule, even though it is highly likely 174,000cbm given TEN's existing 174,000cbm fleet and prior contract - noting this as a probable-but-unsourced fact rather than guessing it into a cited cell. Not in baseline: baseline's only Tsakos row is the single 25-Feb-2026 vessel; this is an additional/second one.
